The '''electromagnetic pulse grenade''', also known as an '''EMP grenade''', '''haywire grenade''',<ref name="Battlefront guide" /> '''Electrostatic Charge Detonator''',<ref name="RCPG" /> '''ECD''',<ref name="RCPG" /> and often referred to by Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] as '''droid poppers''',<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" /> was an anti-[[Droid/Legends|droid]] weapon often used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]&mdash;specifically by the Army's elite soldiers, the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]]&mdash;during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] opponents.

==Description==
[[File:Droid_poppers.png|thumb|left|180px|The effects of an EMP grenade on [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]]]
EMP grenades released a 3-meter blast of disruptive electrical energy that damaged and disabled electronic systems. They were especially useful for disabling droids. These electromagnetic pulses were not quite as effective against organics, but were still capable of electrocuting or stunning lifeforms that had [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic enhancements]].<ref name="Battlefront">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref><ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide" /> Detonations also temporarily disrupted the sensors and visual displays of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper's]] helmet systems for a few seconds, somewhat similar to the effects of the [[reverse-polarity pulse grenade]]. Since the clone commandos had a more electronic helmet, the effect on them would last closer to an hour than just a few seconds.
[[File:DroidekaEMP.png|thumb|The effect of an EMP Grenade on a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]]]]
When rolled at just the right speed, EMP grenades could bypass the shield of a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] and disable it, making them more effective than blasters.

Other anti-droid weapons that produced similar effects were the [[Ion grenade/Legends|ion grenade]] and the [[electromagnetic pulse launcher]].

==History==
EMP grenades were standard-issue weapons for clone troopers<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" /> and were used to disable battle droids of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> They were also carried by [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|clone jet troopers]] who fired them from [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launchers]].<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide" /> Various models were developed and employed by the clone troopers, such as the [[V-6 haywire grenade]]<ref name="Battlefront guide" /> and the [[reverse-polarity pulse grenade]].<ref name="Republic 50">[[Republic 50|''Republic'' 50]]</ref>
